title: Sidebar always expanded
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

I would like to make it so that the sidebar can never be collapsed (i.e. always expanded).

### Why?

Our app has important input widgets in the sidebar. A user immediately closed the sidebar and forgot it had ever existed, so they didn't know to look for the re-expand toggle. They were then unable to use the app.

### How?

An option in st.set_page_config() for example.

### Additional Context

I have looked for a similar issue about keeping the sidebar always collapsed and couldn't find one.

I would like to help implement this. I have a clear use case for this in my own production apps where the sidebar contains critical application navigation. Please let me know if you would like me to draft a proposal for how this could be added to st.set_page_config or another configuration parameter

Hi [USER], thanks for your enhancement request submission!

Though we don't have this as an option in `st.set_page_config` at this point, I wanted to offer the following workaround in the interim:
```python
import streamlit as st

st.set_page_config(initial_sidebar_state="expanded")

# Hides the collapse button so the user is no longer able to close the sidebar
st.html("""
    <style>
        [data-testid="stSidebarCollapseButton"] {
            display: none;
        }
    </style>
""")
```
Thank you [USER] - that workaround works perfectly for now.
